Legendary
=========

OmniLibrary can download Legendary 0.20.43 on demand from the official
Heroic-Games-Launcher release. Legendary is not embedded in the Tools for Steam
source tree or installer.

Project: https://github.com/Heroic-Games-Launcher/legendary
Release asset:
https://github.com/Heroic-Games-Launcher/legendary/releases/download/0.20.43/legendary_windows_x86_64.exe
Expected SHA-256:
ec1ad2d19d44e07b2b0330191c300979f102c509f2a889708099f453c5188f20
License: GNU General Public License v3.0
License text and corresponding source:
https://github.com/Heroic-Games-Launcher/legendary/tree/0.20.43

Tools for Steam stores Legendary and its Epic session in the isolated
data\omnilibrary directory. Disconnect Epic Account removes that session and
the isolated browser profile without deleting installed game files.
